identity.name: Future AGI
identity.one_liner: Open-source platform for evaluating, observing, and improving LLM and AI agent applications.
identity.short_description: Future AGI is an open-source platform for evaluating, observing, and improving LLM and AI agent applications. It covers tracing, evals, simulations, datasets, gateway workflows, guardrails, and self-hostable deployment.

positioning.why_it_matters: Agent teams need more than traces or one-off eval scripts. Future AGI is interesting because it combines evaluation, observability, simulation, datasets, gateway, and guardrails in one platform.
best_for: Teams operating LLM and agent applications
Builders comparing self-hostable evaluation and observability platforms
AI teams that need simulations, datasets, and guardrails together
not_for: Small prototypes that only need a few manual test prompts
Teams looking for a low-level agent framework rather than an operations platform

seo_article.intro: Future AGI is an open-source platform for evaluating, observing, and improving LLM and agent applications.
seo_article.what_it_is: It combines traces, evals, simulations, datasets, gateway workflows, and guardrails in a self-hostable platform.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Agent quality needs structured measurement and operations loops before workflows reach real users.
seo_article.how_it_works: Instrument one agent path, add evaluation datasets, and use traces and guardrails to inspect regressions.

faq.question: Is Future AGI open source?
faq.answer: Yes. The GitHub repository is listed under the Apache-2.0 license.

faq.question: Who should evaluate Future AGI?
faq.answer: Teams shipping production LLM or agent applications should evaluate it as an evaluation and observability layer.
